☀️ Profile — check-in questions
Choose what the morning and evening prompts ask. Fewer questions get answered more often than more questions do.
👤 Profile & TDEE
Estimates your daily energy expenditure (Mifflin-St Jeor BMR × activity multiplier). Honest caveat: formula estimates are ±300-500 cal off actual TDEE for most people — the activity guess is the biggest source of error. Treat the number as a starting point, not a precise target.
🏠 Home / QoL Tasks
Daily and weekly life-admin tasks — make bed, dishes, bathrooms, laundry. They surface as check-off rows in your daily card. Weekly tasks stay visible but go quiet for 6 days after one check.
Add a task
🚣 Concept2 Logbook
Enter your API token from log.concept2.com/developers/keys. Stored locally only — never sent anywhere except Concept2.
🚣 Recent Rows (from C2 Logbook)
Connect to see your rowing data
⌚ Apple Health Import
Export your data from iPhone: Settings → Health → Export All Health Data. Upload the ZIP here to import steps, heart rate, sleep, and workouts. Walk/run/cycle/swim auto-fill your daily log — no double entry.
💪 Recover Bodyweight Reps
Scans this device's local storage for any bodyweight rep data (push-ups, sit-ups, squats, crunches, oblique crunches) and saves it to the database. Run this once on each device where you previously tracked reps.
